panels.is: Jason, a cartoon version of the game's Jason as players know him in the first hours: short dark hair, trimmed dark beard, plain olive short-sleeved shirt open at the neck, dark trousers. Front, side, back, then the bust as the windscreen will frame him. Flat cartoon house style, circle hands by design.

Lucia, a cartoon version of the game's Lucia in the first hours: brown skin, dark hair in a high ponytail, small gold hoop earrings, fitted light-blue short-sleeved scoop-neck top, gold chain, light jeans. Front, side, back, then the bust. Must read clearly as a woman at phone size.

An invented autistic woman, 25, white, auburn hair: brief says a cream jumper with a unicorn being sick rainbows, and jeans; the director asked for her to be prettier and cooler (shaggy auburn cut with a fringe, a small nose stud, big headphones round her neck). Front, side, back, then the bust. She sits in the middle of a car's back seat, seen front on.
